descriptor: EV drivetrain and motor maker moving into robotics and railways
lede: Sona Comstar (Sona BLW Precision Forgings) makes differentials, gears, EV traction and suspension motors and controllers. BEVs now exceed half of automotive revenue and the ₹25,100 Cr order book is the second largest in its history, but margins have slid to 23% at the bottom of the 23-25% range and the stock trades at about 73x earnings.

short_version.text: Q2 FY27 revenue ₹1,546 Cr (+35%), BEV revenue +129%, free cash flow of ₹446 Cr in H1, 75 EPIC programmes across 37 customers and a Denso joint-venture structure for motors.

EBITDA margin has fallen 2.3 points year on year on traction-motor mix and input inflation, ROCE has dropped from 24% to 14% as equity rose sharply (reserves doubled in FY25), and the 10x-in-10-years ambition has no rupee target.
About 73x earnings and 46x EBITDA leave little room for margin disappointment.

blocks.text: Sona Comstar supplies automotive OEMs with differential assemblies, gears, EV traction motors, suspension motors, controllers, sensors and railway products. In H1 FY27 BEV revenue was 48% of automotive sales (30% a year earlier). Management is widening its priority from electrification to 'EPIC' (electric, personalised, intelligent, connected) mobility, including robotics orders.

items.text: Two Denso JVs: JV1 (2- and 3-wheeler motors) to close by about December 2026, JV2 (high-voltage) in H1 CY2027. Terms are not disclosed.

blocks.title: Net profit vs operating cash flow, ₹ Cr

items.text: Healthy: cash conversion above 100% of profit over five years; H1 FY27 operating cash flow was 90% of EBITDA.
ROIIC over FY24-FY26 only about 4% because capital employed jumped ₹3,363 Cr (reserves roughly doubled in FY25) while EBIT rose slowly.

blocks.text: Management is open about weaknesses (it started the Q2 remarks with margins) and has not changed the margin range despite two quarters at the bottom of it. The ambitions are long-dated and not measurable.

The Denso JV terms and economics are undisclosed. Annual-report checks (auditor, related parties) were not made for this note.

items.text: Engineering depth (patents, in-house R&D), long OEM qualification cycles and 75 EPIC programmes already won.
US EV deliveries are flat, EV programmes depend on a few OEMs' vehicle launches, and raw-material and freight inflation is running high.

cells: Traction-motor mix and input costs keep pulling it down

items.name: Bull
items.text: ₹7,500 Cr revenue at 15.5% net margin (₹1,160 Cr), valued at 60x.

blocks.text: Scenarios are illustrative, built on our own assumptions, not a forecast or advice.

Sona has real growth (revenue +42% over the last twelve months) and a strong balance sheet, but the price assumes margins hold at 23-25% while the mix moves to lower-margin motors. The base case treats the stock as roughly fairly priced; the bear case shows how much a de-rating can cost.
